headline: Week 13: Jerry Jeudy Remembered He's In The NFL And So Did Hot Cocks
subhead: Stroud Boys benched 36 points and still couldn't outscore a Pop Warner team, while Jeudy dropped a 40-piece on Put an AR to My Head's funeral.
matchOfTheWeek: Jets' Juniors 159.72 vs Bo Nix Celli 154.62 was the only fight worth watching — Brock Bowers turned in a 35.2 burger and Caleb Williams added 26 and Celli STILL lost. Wunder's squad hit a 97% efficient Bo lineup over the head with a folding chair by five points. Somewhere Nick is staring at a Bowers box score wondering how the universe keeps finding new ways to mug him.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the war crime: Hot Cocks 159.74, Stroud Boys 116.28. BigD didn't just beat bjewett, he made him watch. Stroud Boys left 36.80 points on the bench — that's not a lineup mistake, that's a cry for help. Jonnu Smith goes for 26.3 and Adam Thielen drops 23.9 ON THE BENCH and your starting lineup still looks like a Week 4 waiver wire. Optimal would've been 153. You scored 116. Read a projection, my guy.

OnlyFants put up 150 and it might as well have been 250 the way Kyle's team got fed into a woodchipper — 119.70 is criminal in a SuperFlex league, Dech. Jerry Jeudy went FORTY POINTS for Cubby. Forty. The same Jerry Jeudy you've been ignoring on the waiver wire since 2022. Pat Freiermuth rotting on Put an AR's bench for 21.8 was the cherry on a very sad sundae.

T swift's Baddies lost by 7.44 to The Good Ladds while Jameis Winston dropped THIRTY-FIVE POINT NINE EIGHT on her bench. Tnicolle, that's the entire margin and a tip. Mig won despite Bryce Young (yes, that one) putting up 23.62 in street clothes — this league's QB management is a public health crisis. Russell Wilson also dumped 27.86 on Szara's bench, but 226 Alpha squeezed past LargestofRocks by 4.60 anyway thanks to David Njoku going full beast mode for 30.7. LargestofRocks had Jayden Daniels (28.64) AND Trey McBride (27.60) and still lost — that's a special kind of pain.

MassiveCocks led the league with 161.84 and dispatched The Olave Garden by 8 despite Terry McLaurin's 27.3 — Patrickreegs played well and got smoked anyway, which is just the 2024 experience.

powerRankings.blurb: League-high 161.84 and the roster looks like it was built in a lab to ruin everyone's December.
A 43-point beatdown of Stroud Boys is the kind of stat-padding that gets you a #2 seed and a restraining order.
Jerry Jeudy 40, Bucky Irving 27 — Cubby's hitting on lottery tickets while the rest of you are scratching expired ones.
Scored 153 and lost, which is the universe's way of saying you peaked at the right time but in the wrong matchup.
97.4% efficiency, 154 points, and an L — Celli is the league's most optimized loser.
Survived a 154-point Celli explosion by 5; the Jets' name is unfortunately not just for show some weeks.
Josh Allen carried a roster that had Bryce Young dropping 23 in flip-flops on the bench.
Lost by 7.44 with a 35.98 Jameis Winston bench bomb — managerial malpractice with a cute logo.
Won by 4.6 and could've won by 32 if Russell Wilson wasn't holding hands with the bench.
Two top-six starters and still lost by 4.6 — naming yourself after rocks finally tracking with the IQ readings.

powerRankings.team: Put an AR to My Head
powerRankings.blurb: 119 points in SuperFlex is the literal embodiment of your team name, Dech.
Left 36.8 points on the bench in a 43-point loss — the only team that could lose to itself and still finish second.
